title: xi dats build order
description: The projects `xi dats build --all` builds, in order. Every table any of them edits in place (database records, zone dialog, NPC names and events, spell / command records) is reset from its .base once, then each project is built on top of the ones before it, so projects that share a table layer the same way every time. Keep it at projects/build_order.json (--order names another).

projects.description: Each project: a name (projects/<name>.json), or a path to a project file relative to this file (a zone editor project's dats.json). Built first to last.

result.description: Written by the last --all build: per target, the tables it reset and the projects edit. The next --all resets these too, so a table a project no longer edits (or a project taken off the list) goes back as well.

examples.description: The server's client build: the base tweaks, then the Abyssea content, then the zone editor's cutscenes.
